items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen for fast everyday agentic workflows
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，專為快速日常代理工作流程設計
items_flat.summary_en: Google announced Gemini 4 Hydrogen on Nov 12 as its speed-focused model for everyday coding and agentic tasks. It finishes tasks 2.5x faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash at default high thinking, more than triples Terminal-Bench 4.1 scores, and surpasses Argon on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (51 vs 50) while priced flat at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens across a 1M context window. It is rolling out broadly to developers, enterprises, the Gemini app, Search and Antigravity for Pro/Ultra subscribers, with four tunable thinking levels and multi-model orchestration support.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 於 11 月 12 日宣布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，作為專為日常編碼與代理任務設計的速度型模型。預設高思考層級下任務完成速度比 Gemini 3.8 Flash 快 2.5 倍，Terminal-Bench 4.1 分數提升逾三倍，並在 Artificial Analysis 智能指數上超越 Argon（51 對 50），全 1M 上下文定價為每百萬 token $1.50/$7.50。現正廣泛推出至開發者、企業、Gemini 應用、搜尋與 Antigravity（Pro/Ultra 訂閱者），支援四級可調思考與多模型編排。
items_flat.analysis_en: Hydrogen fills the efficiency gap for high-volume agentic work and multi-model pipelines, potentially lowering costs versus frontier models, but real-world reliability versus Carbon/Argon and sustained benchmark edges will determine adoption.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Hydrogen 填補大量代理工作與多模型流程的效率缺口，可能降低相對前沿模型的成本，但實際可靠性與相對 Carbon/Argon 的持續優勢將決定採用程度。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，將尖端智能帶給所有人——以速度與效率處理日常編碼與代理工作流程。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic IPO roadshow continues with ~6x oversubscription reported
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic IPO 路演持續，傳認購約超額 6 倍
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s IPO roadshow continued on Nov 12, with the company linking its offering site. Updated filings set a $70–$78 range for 825 million Class A shares (ticker ANT), implying up to roughly $1.4 trillion fully diluted valuation and up to ~$90 billion total raise including a $26 billion private placement with cornerstone investors such as Google, Nvidia and AMD. Bloomberg/Reuters reported the deal is about six times oversubscribed, with bankers prioritizing existing backers; shares are expected to price Nov 18 and trade Nov 19 on Nasdaq.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic IPO 路演於 11 月 12 日持續，公司連結其發行網站。更新申報設定 8.25 億股 Class A（代碼 ANT）價格區間 $70–$78，隱含完全稀釋估值最高約 1.4 兆美元，含 $260 億私人配售（Google、Nvidia、AMD 等基石投資者）總募資最高約 900 億美元。Bloomberg/Reuters 報導認購約超額 6 倍，銀行優先現有支持者；預計 11 月 18 日定價、19 日於 Nasdaq 開始交易。
items_flat.analysis_en: Strong demand signals robust investor interest in AI despite valuation and circular-financing concerns, but final pricing, allocation and post-listing performance remain key tests of market appetite.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 強勁需求顯示投資人對 AI 的興趣依然旺盛，儘管存在估值與循環融資疑慮；最終定價、分配與上市後表現仍是市場接受度的關鍵考驗。

items_flat.title_en: Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon generally available
items_flat.title_zh: Google 將 Gemini 4 Carbon 全面開放
items_flat.summary_en: Google announced on Nov 10 that Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest frontier model for long-horizon agentic work, cybersecurity, coding and scientific reasoning, is now available to paying developers via the Gemini API in AI Studio and Gemini for business, and to Ultra subscribers in the Gemini app, AI Mode and Antigravity. Introductory API pricing is $2/$10 per million input/output tokens through Nov 30.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 於 11 月 10 日宣布 Gemini 4 Carbon（其最強前沿模型，擅長長程代理、網路安全、編碼與科學推理）現已透過 Gemini API 在 AI Studio 與 Gemini for business 向付費開發者開放，並向 Ultra 訂閱者在 Gemini 應用、AI Mode 與 Antigravity 提供。API 入門價至 11 月 30 日為每百萬 token $2/$10。
items_flat.analysis_en: Carbon’s broader release strengthens Google’s position in high-stakes agentic and cyber workflows at competitive introductory pricing, but sustained performance versus rivals and production reliability will determine long-term impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Carbon 更廣泛釋出強化 Google 在高風險代理與網路安全工作流程的地位，並以具競爭力的入門定價推出，但相對競爭對手的持續表現與生產可靠性將決定長期影響。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re making Gemini 4 Carbon available to developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers. Carbon is our strongest model with frontier performance in cybersecurity capabilities and long-horizon agentic workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們將Gemini 4 Carbon開放給開發者、企業、科學家與消費者。Carbon是我們最強的模型，在網路安全能力與長時程代理工作流程上具有前沿表現。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI research shows CoT monitorability declines as models scale
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 研究顯示模型規模擴大時思路鏈可監控性下降
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published research on Nov 10 (shared widely Nov 11) examining how pretraining, architecture, RL and model-generated data affect chain-of-thought monitorability proxies (no-CoT capability and CoT controllability). Findings indicate that as models improve (lower perplexity) and undergo RL, they become harder to monitor via CoT, with controllability rising even without direct process supervision on the CoT.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 11 月 10 日發表研究（11 月 11 日廣泛分享），檢視預訓練、架構、RL 與模型生成資料如何影響思路鏈可監控性代理指標（無 CoT 能力與 CoT 可控性）。發現顯示模型改善（困惑度降低）與 RL 後，透過 CoT 監控變得更難，即使無直接 CoT 過程監督，可控性仍上升。
items_flat.analysis_en: The work highlights a structural safety challenge as capability scales, suggesting monitorability is not automatically preserved and may require deliberate training choices, though the proxies remain imperfect for adversarial cases.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此研究凸顯能力擴展時的結構性安全挑戰，顯示可監控性並非自動保留，可能需刻意訓練選擇，但代理指標對對抗情境仍 imperfect。
items_flat.quote: These are imperfect proxies for monitorability, but together they indicate that models will become harder to monitor through their CoT as we scale toward more intelligent systems.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這些是可監控性的 imperfect 代理，但合起來顯示，當我們擴展至更智能系統時，模型將變得更難透過其 CoT 被監控。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind releases AlphaGenome 2 for cell-specific DNA variant prediction
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind 釋出 AlphaGenome 2，用於細胞專一 DNA 變異預測
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced AlphaGenome 2 on Nov 11, a next-generation DNA sequence model that predicts how genetic variants affect specific human cell types and states, trained on over 100 million cell profiles. It identifies nearly twice as many causal variants as the original on the TenK10K dataset and supports on-the-fly conditioning from new single-cell data. Available for non-commercial research via the AlphaGenome API.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 於 11 月 11 日宣布 AlphaGenome 2，下一代 DNA 序列模型，可預測基因變異如何影響特定人類細胞類型與狀態，以逾 1 億細胞輪廓訓練。在 TenK10K 資料集上識別因果變異數量近乎前代兩倍，並支援從新單細胞資料即時條件化。透過 AlphaGenome API 供非商業研究使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: By moving from tissue averages to cell-type resolution and supporting on-the-fly conditioning from new single-cell data, AlphaGenome 2 could accelerate variant-to-mechanism research, though commercial access remains limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 從組織平均轉向細胞類型解析度，並支援新單細胞資料即時條件化，AlphaGenome 2 或可加速變異至機制研究，但商業存取仍受限。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are announcing AlphaGenome 2, our next-generation model that predicts how DNA sequences and their variations impact specific human cell types, giving scientists a powerful new tool to uncover the cellular drivers of disease.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們宣布AlphaGenome 2，我們的下一代模型，能預測DNA序列及其變異如何影響特定人類細胞類型，為科學家提供強大新工具，以揭示疾病的細胞驅動因素。

items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini Decisions API powered by Gemini Decision 1
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出由 Gemini Decision 1 驅動的 Gemini Decisions API
items_flat.summary_en: Google introduced the Gemini Decisions API on Nov 11, powered by the new Gemini Decision 1 model. It evaluates up to 1,000 yes/no, choice or rubric questions against one multimodal input (text, image, audio, video, PDF) in a single fast pass, aimed at routing, policy checks and grading without full generation.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 於 11 月 11 日推出 Gemini Decisions API，由新 Gemini Decision 1 模型驅動。可針對單一多模態輸入（文字、影像、音訊、影片、PDF）在單次快速通過中評估最多 1,000 個是非、選擇或量表問題，用於路由、政策檢查與評分，無需完整生成。
items_flat.analysis_en: Purpose-built for routing, policy checks and grading without full generation, the API could cut latency and cost for agent control planes, but its advantage depends on calibration accuracy and integration ease.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 專為無需完整生成的路由、政策檢查與評分設計，此 API 或可降低代理控制平面的延遲與成本，但其優勢取決於校準準確度與整合便利性。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing the Gemini Decisions API, a new endpoint for fast, closed-set decisions powered by our new Gemini Decision 1 model... returning probabilities and confidence scores in 150-250 ms end-to-end latency at $0.10 per 1M input tokens with zero output tokens billed.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini Decisions API，一個由新Gemini Decision 1模型驅動的快速閉集決策新端點……以150-250毫秒端到端延遲回傳機率與信心分數，每百萬輸入token 0.10美元且輸出token不計費。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind’s AlphaProof Code formally verifies Signal protocol implementation
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind 的 AlphaProof Code 正式驗證 Signal 協議實作
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced AlphaProof Code on Nov 10, an agentic framework that guided AI agents (powered by Gemini Carbon) to generate over six million lines of Lean proofs formally verifying key security properties of the actual compiled Signal protocol implementation in about four weeks.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 於 11 月 10 日宣布 AlphaProof Code，一種代理框架，引導 AI 代理（由 Gemini Carbon 驅動）在約四週內生成逾 600 萬行 Lean 證明，正式驗證實際編譯 Signal 協議實作的關鍵安全屬性。
items_flat.analysis_en: Bridging design-to-implementation verification with AI agents marks a practical advance for high-assurance software, potentially scalable to other critical systems, though human expertise remains essential.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 以 AI 代理橋接設計到實作驗證，標誌高保證軟體的實用進展，或可擴展至其他關鍵系統，但人類專業仍不可或缺。
items_flat.quote: This breakthrough discovery was made using AlphaProof Code, a novel agentic framework for formal verification at unprecedented depth... Our work marks the first time AI has been used to formally verify a widely deployed cryptographic protocol at this depth.
items_flat.quote_zh: 此突破發現使用AlphaProof Code，一種前所未有深度的新型代理形式驗證框架……我們的工作標誌首次使用AI以如此深度正式驗證廣泛部署的加密協議。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics 2.5 for faster real-world dexterity
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind 推出 Gemini Robotics 2.5，提升真實世界靈巧度
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5 on Nov 10, its most capable vision-language-action model, improving skill breadth, learning speed, reliability (96% success in a Mercedes-Benz Apptronik Apollo pilot) and safety steerability. It natively supports platforms including Apollo 2 and Franka Duo and is available to robotics partners.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 於 11 月 10 日釋出 Gemini Robotics 2.5，其最有能力的視覺-語言-行動模型，提升技能廣度、學習速度、可靠性（Mercedes-Benz Apptronik Apollo 試點 96% 成功率）與安全可操控性。原生支援 Apollo 2 與 Franka Duo 等平台，向機器人合作夥伴提供。
items_flat.analysis_en: Demonstrated factory success and safety improvements advance physical AI practicality, yet partner-only rollout and the gap to widespread deployment leave the timeline for everyday robots uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 工廠成功展示與安全改進推進物理 AI 實用性，但僅限合作夥伴推出與廣泛部署差距，使日常機器人時程仍不明朗。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are introducing Gemini Robotics 2.5, our most capable vision-language-action (VLA) model to date. Gemini Robotics 2.5 increases both the breadth of skills a robot can learn and the speed at which it can acquire them.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini Robotics 2.5，迄今最強的視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型。Gemini Robotics 2.5提升機器人能學習的技能廣度與習得速度。

items_flat.title_en: Google rolls out Gemini app with Gemini Live on Apple CarPlay
items_flat.title_zh: Google 在 Apple CarPlay 推出 Gemini 應用與 Gemini Live
items_flat.summary_en: Google announced on Nov 11 that the Gemini app, including Gemini Live, is rolling out globally on Apple CarPlay for iOS users in supported languages. Drivers can continue conversations or start new ones hands-free for calendar briefings, inbox catch-ups and brainstorming; chats sync with the phone app. It does not replace Siri for calls, messages or navigation.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 於 11 月 11 日宣布 Gemini 應用（含 Gemini Live）正全球向支援語言的 iOS 使用者在 Apple CarPlay 推出。駕駛可免持繼續對話或開啟新對話，進行日曆簡報、收件匣追蹤與腦力激盪；對話與手機應用同步。無法取代 Siri 進行通話、訊息或導航。
items_flat.analysis_en: Closing the gap with other AI assistants on CarPlay expands Gemini’s surface area for everyday use, but limited action capabilities keep it complementary rather than a full in-car replacement.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 補上 CarPlay 上其他 AI 助理的缺口，擴大 Gemini 日常使用表面，但有限行動能力使其仍為輔助而非完整車載替代。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re bringing the Gemini app directly to Apple CarPlay.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們將 Gemini 應用直接帶到 Apple CarPlay。

google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 於 11 月 11 日宣布 AlphaGenome 2，下一代 DNA 序列模型，可預測基因變異如何影響特定人類細胞類型與狀態，以逾 1 億細胞輪廓訓練。在 TenK10K 資料集上識別因果變異數量近乎前代兩倍，並支援從新單細胞資料即時條件化。透過 AlphaGenome API 供非商業研究使用。
google.analysis_en: By moving from tissue averages to cell-type resolution and supporting on-the-fly conditioning from new single-cell data, AlphaGenome 2 could accelerate variant-to-mechanism research, though commercial access remains limited.
google.analysis_zh: 從組織平均轉向細胞類型解析度，並支援新單細胞資料即時條件化，AlphaGenome 2 或可加速變異至機制研究，但商業存取仍受限。
google.quote: Today, we are announcing AlphaGenome 2, our next-generation model that predicts how DNA sequences and their variations impact specific human cell types, giving scientists a powerful new tool to uncover the cellular drivers of disease.
google.quote_zh: 今天，我們宣布AlphaGenome 2，我們的下一代模型，能預測DNA序列及其變異如何影響特定人類細胞類型，為科學家提供強大新工具，以揭示疾病的細胞驅動因素。

google.title_en: Google launches Gemini Decisions API powered by Gemini Decision 1
google.title_zh: Google 推出由 Gemini Decision 1 驅動的 Gemini Decisions API
google.summary_en: Google introduced the Gemini Decisions API on Nov 11, powered by the new Gemini Decision 1 model. It evaluates up to 1,000 yes/no, choice or rubric questions against one multimodal input (text, image, audio, video, PDF) in a single fast pass, aimed at routing, policy checks and grading without full generation.
google.summary_zh: Google 於 11 月 11 日推出 Gemini Decisions API，由新 Gemini Decision 1 模型驅動。可針對單一多模態輸入（文字、影像、音訊、影片、PDF）在單次快速通過中評估最多 1,000 個是非、選擇或量表問題，用於路由、政策檢查與評分，無需完整生成。
google.analysis_en: Purpose-built for routing, policy checks and grading without full generation, the API could cut latency and cost for agent control planes, but its advantage depends on calibration accuracy and integration ease.
google.analysis_zh: 專為無需完整生成的路由、政策檢查與評分設計，此 API 或可降低代理控制平面的延遲與成本，但其優勢取決於校準準確度與整合便利性。
google.quote: Today, we’re introducing the Gemini Decisions API, a new endpoint for fast, closed-set decisions powered by our new Gemini Decision 1 model... returning probabilities and confidence scores in 150-250 ms end-to-end latency at $0.10 per 1M input tokens with zero output tokens billed.
google.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini Decisions API，一個由新Gemini Decision 1模型驅動的快速閉集決策新端點……以150-250毫秒端到端延遲回傳機率與信心分數，每百萬輸入token 0.10美元且輸出token不計費。

google.title_en: DeepMind’s AlphaProof Code formally verifies Signal protocol implementation
google.title_zh: DeepMind 的 AlphaProof Code 正式驗證 Signal 協議實作
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced AlphaProof Code on Nov 10, an agentic framework that guided AI agents (powered by Gemini Carbon) to generate over six million lines of Lean proofs formally verifying key security properties of the actual compiled Signal protocol implementation in about four weeks.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 於 11 月 10 日宣布 AlphaProof Code，一種代理框架，引導 AI 代理（由 Gemini Carbon 驅動）在約四週內生成逾 600 萬行 Lean 證明，正式驗證實際編譯 Signal 協議實作的關鍵安全屬性。
google.analysis_en: Bridging design-to-implementation verification with AI agents marks a practical advance for high-assurance software, potentially scalable to other critical systems, though human expertise remains essential.
google.analysis_zh: 以 AI 代理橋接設計到實作驗證，標誌高保證軟體的實用進展，或可擴展至其他關鍵系統，但人類專業仍不可或缺。
google.quote: This breakthrough discovery was made using AlphaProof Code, a novel agentic framework for formal verification at unprecedented depth... Our work marks the first time AI has been used to formally verify a widely deployed cryptographic protocol at this depth.
google.quote_zh: 此突破發現使用AlphaProof Code，一種前所未有深度的新型代理形式驗證框架……我們的工作標誌首次使用AI以如此深度正式驗證廣泛部署的加密協議。

google.title_en: DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics 2.5 for faster real-world dexterity
google.title_zh: DeepMind 推出 Gemini Robotics 2.5，提升真實世界靈巧度
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5 on Nov 10, its most capable vision-language-action model, improving skill breadth, learning speed, reliability (96% success in a Mercedes-Benz Apptronik Apollo pilot) and safety steerability. It natively supports platforms including Apollo 2 and Franka Duo and is available to robotics partners.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 於 11 月 10 日釋出 Gemini Robotics 2.5，其最有能力的視覺-語言-行動模型，提升技能廣度、學習速度、可靠性（Mercedes-Benz Apptronik Apollo 試點 96% 成功率）與安全可操控性。原生支援 Apollo 2 與 Franka Duo 等平台，向機器人合作夥伴提供。
google.analysis_en: Demonstrated factory success and safety improvements advance physical AI practicality, yet partner-only rollout and the gap to widespread deployment leave the timeline for everyday robots uncertain.
google.analysis_zh: 工廠成功展示與安全改進推進物理 AI 實用性，但僅限合作夥伴推出與廣泛部署差距，使日常機器人時程仍不明朗。
google.quote: Today, we are introducing Gemini Robotics 2.5, our most capable vision-language-action (VLA) model to date. Gemini Robotics 2.5 increases both the breadth of skills a robot can learn and the speed at which it can acquire them.
google.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini Robotics 2.5，迄今最強的視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型。Gemini Robotics 2.5提升機器人能學習的技能廣度與習得速度。

google.title_en: Google rolls out Gemini app with Gemini Live on Apple CarPlay
google.title_zh: Google 在 Apple CarPlay 推出 Gemini 應用與 Gemini Live
google.summary_en: Google announced on Nov 11 that the Gemini app, including Gemini Live, is rolling out globally on Apple CarPlay for iOS users in supported languages. Drivers can continue conversations or start new ones hands-free for calendar briefings, inbox catch-ups and brainstorming; chats sync with the phone app. It does not replace Siri for calls, messages or navigation.
google.summary_zh: Google 於 11 月 11 日宣布 Gemini 應用（含 Gemini Live）正全球向支援語言的 iOS 使用者在 Apple CarPlay 推出。駕駛可免持繼續對話或開啟新對話，進行日曆簡報、收件匣追蹤與腦力激盪；對話與手機應用同步。無法取代 Siri 進行通話、訊息或導航。
google.analysis_en: Closing the gap with other AI assistants on CarPlay expands Gemini’s surface area for everyday use, but limited action capabilities keep it complementary rather than a full in-car replacement.
google.analysis_zh: 補上 CarPlay 上其他 AI 助理的缺口，擴大 Gemini 日常使用表面，但有限行動能力使其仍為輔助而非完整車載替代。
google.quote: Today we’re bringing the Gemini app directly to Apple CarPlay.
google.quote_zh: 今天我們將 Gemini 應用直接帶到 Apple CarPlay。

brief_en: Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen for fast everyday agentic work while Anthropic’s IPO drew roughly 6x oversubscription. OpenAI shared research on declining chain-of-thought monitorability; prior Google releases on Carbon, AlphaGenome 2, Decisions API, AlphaProof and Robotics remain the day’s other highlights.
brief_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 作為快速日常代理模型，Anthropic IPO 認購約超額 6 倍。OpenAI 公布思路鏈可監控性研究；Google 先前 Carbon、AlphaGenome 2、Decisions API、AlphaProof 與 Robotics 仍為今日其他重點。
